honest_notes: Synthetic seeded corpus; ~10% near-duplicates per bucket. corpus_mode=dense: every doc shares a common template, so MinHash-LSH buckets collapse toward all-pairs — the adversarial worst case for the pre-filter (no win over brute force). corpus_mode=diverse: per-topic vocabularies, so LSH prunes the O(n^2) scan (the realistic win). Curation ALSO calls ConsolidationService._find_contradictions, so curation inherits the same scaling behaviour as consolidation. The scoring loop itself is O(n); the contradiction scan dominates. Not a throughput claim; the cost curve is the finding.
